source: Social Security Administration (SSA), Change in Name Popularity from 2024 to 2025
snapshotMethod: Extract the name, 2025 rank and 2024 rank from each gender section of the three official SSA HTML tables. Keep 2025 ranks 1 through 1000, record the originating table, and sort boys then girls by ascending rank. The union contains exactly one name for every rank 1 through 1000 for each gender. This normalized CSV is a source transcription, not the unavailable national ZIP download.
selection: Use exactly the 2025 published ranks 1–1000 for each recorded sex, in ascending rank order. Generation is uniform.
licenseScope: The official Data.gov catalogue record for this federal agency dataset explicitly declares CC0 1.0. The source consists of aggregate name statistics, not person-level records.
attribution: Source: Social Security Administration, 2025 birth-name ranks. Selected and formatted by this library; no agency endorsement is implied.
